narrative.title: The Server Room Power Ledger
narrative.scenario: A datacenter logs rack activations as 1s and idle slots as 0s across a duty cycle. Facilities wants to know how many contiguous stretches of the cycle drew exactly a target amount of power. Each stretch is identified by its start and end position, so identical stretches at different positions count separately.
narrative.inputFormat: A binary array nums and an integer goal.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the number of non-empty contiguous subarrays whose elements sum to goal.

testCases.explanation: The qualifying stretches are [1,0,1], [1,0,1,0], [0,1,0,1] and [1,0,1] again at a later start.
Every one of the 15 contiguous stretches sums to zero.
